summary: This 6-K reports the entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of 6.4 million ADSs at $125.00 per ADS, projecting net proceeds of ~$759.8 million. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing F-3 registration statement, not a special situation. It describes customary underwriting terms, closing expected July 6, 2026, and forward-looking statements. No special-situation framework is implicated; the event is a capital raise via a marketed offering, not a restructuring, activist campaign, or other definitive special case.
